1061.description: A single-leg version of the barbell hip thrust that demands more balance and glute strength on each side.
instructions: Set your upper back on a bench with a padded barbell over your hips.
Extend one leg or hold it bent in the air.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top without twisting.
Lower under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1125.description: A push-up with feet in the straps and one hand lifted, building chest strength and total-body stability.
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a plank with one hand on the floor.
Brace your core firmly.
Lower your chest by bending the supporting elbow.
Keep your hips level and avoid twisting.
Press back up.
Complete your reps, then switch hands.

1189.description: A V-shaped crunch on a bosu ball with added weight, which challenges the abs and balance together.
instructions: Sit on a bosu ball and lean back slightly, holding a weight in front of you.
Lift your feet off the floor with your legs bent or straight.
Bring your chest and knees toward each other in a V shape.
Lower back with control, keeping your spine long.
Stay stable on the ball throughout.

1253.description: A donkey calf raise on a lever machine. It trains the calves.
instructions: Adjust the leverage machine to the appropriate height for your body.
Position yourself facing the machine, with your toes on the foot platform and your heels hanging off the edge.
Place your hands on the handles or the support bars for stability.
Engage your calves and lift your heels as high as possible, using the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机调节至适合您身体的高度。
面向机器定位，脚趾放在脚踏平台上，脚后跟悬在边缘。
将手放在手柄或支撑杆上以保持稳定性。
用脚掌收紧小腿并尽可能高地抬起脚后跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1317.description: A barbell row with an underhand grip, done chest down on an incline bench. The support removes momentum and targets the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench facing the backrest with your chest against it.
Grab the barbell with a reverse grip (palms facing down) and hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Pull the barbell towards your upper abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，面向靠背，胸部靠在靠背上。
反握（手掌朝下）抓住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将杠铃拉向上腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢地将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1381.description: A one-leg seated calf raise with a dumbbell held with your palm up. It works the soleus under the calf one side at a time.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place it on top of your thigh, palm facing up.
Lift one leg off the ground and extend it in front of you, keeping your knee slightly bent.
Raise your heel as high as possible by pushing through the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住哑铃，将其放在大腿上方，掌心朝上。
将一条腿抬离地面并将其延伸到您面前，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
通过脚掌推动，尽可能高地抬起脚后跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

1445.description: Holding the bottom of a Romanian deadlift with dumbbells. It loads the hamstrings in their stretched position.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs.
Stop when you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold the position with a flat back.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then stand up.

1509.description: A barbell squat to a bench with chains adding load as you stand. It builds leg and hip strength and teaches consistent depth.
instructions: Set a bench behind you and load the bar with chains.
Place the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit back and down until you touch the bench lightly.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand, feeling the chains add weight.

1573.description: A seated machine squat done on one leg. It lets you load each leg separately with good support.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place one foot on the platform at about shoulder width.
Lower under control by bending your knee.
Keep your heel flat and your knee in line with your toes.
Press back up, then switch legs after your reps.

1637.description: An overhead cable curl while sitting on an exercise ball. The ball adds core demand to the biceps work.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball and hold the cable handle with an underhand grip.
Extend your arms fully overhead, keeping your elbows close to your ears.
Slowly curl the cable down towards your forehead, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，用反手握住电缆手柄。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，保持肘部靠近耳朵。
慢慢地将电缆朝前额卷曲，保持上臂静止。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1701.description: A close grip push-up with your hands on a medicine ball. It hits the triceps and challenges stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands on the medicine ball, shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Push back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手放在健身球上，距离与肩同宽。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
推回起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1765.description: A standing upright row with dumbbells, pulling the weights up toward your chin. Trains the shoulders and traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Let the dumbbells hang in front of your thighs, with your arms fully extended and your palms facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, exhale and lift the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Continue lifting until the dumbbells are at shoulder height, with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
让哑铃悬挂在大腿前面，双臂完全伸展，手掌面向身体。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，呼气，将哑铃笔直向上举至下巴，用肘部引导。
继续举起哑铃，直到哑铃与肩同高，肘部指向两侧。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1829.description: Leaning into a wall with your elbow bent overhead stretches the triceps. The wall gives a steady anchor.
instructions: Stand next to a wall and place your bent elbow on it above head height.
Lean your body forward and down until you feel the stretch along the back of your upper arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1893.description: Deep squat hold that opens the ankles and calves.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sink into a deep squat with your heels down.
Hold on to a support if needed.
Gently shift your weight forward over your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Stand up slowly.

1957.description: Standing with the top of the foot on the floor to stretch the muscles at the front of the shin.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently press the foot down by bending the standing knee.
Feel the stretch along the front of the shin and ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2149.description: A kneeling kickback with a band that isolates the glutes by pressing the bent leg up and back.
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around one foot, then get on all fours.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Press the foot with the bent knee up toward the ceiling against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

2277.description: A plate-loaded chest press that trains the pecs and triceps along a guided path.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pulled together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Do not lock your elbows.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2341.description: A side-by-side form check for arm path during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Lie on the bench and unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your arms move in a controlled line and the bar tracks over the lower chest.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2405.description: A cable pushdown with a v-bar and an arm blaster. Isolates the triceps.
instructions: Attach a v-bar attachment to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Engage your triceps and exhale as you push the v-bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your triceps.
Inhale as you slowly return the v-bar to the starting position, maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 在最高设置下将 V 形杆附件连接到电缆机上。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住 V 形杆，手掌朝下，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
收紧三头肌并呼气，同时向下推 V 形杆，直到手臂完全伸展。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，挤压你的三头肌。
吸气，同时缓慢地将 V 形杆返回到起始位置，保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。

2469.description: A crunch on a stability ball with the legs in a frog position to hit the lower abs.
instructions: Lie back on a stability ball with your lower back supported.
Place the soles of your feet together with your knees out.
Place your hands lightly by your head.
Crunch up while pulling your knees toward your chest.
Squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2661.description: A seated cable row with a V-shaped grip that trains the mid back and lats.
instructions: Sit at the cable row station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grip the V bar and sit tall with arms extended.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and avoid rocking.

2725.description: Carrying a heavy load up a flight of stairs, building leg power and grip.
instructions: Pick up the load and hold it against your chest.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Climb the stairs one step at a time.
Push through your whole foot and keep your chest up.
Set the load down under control at the top.

2789.description: Tilting the wrist toward the little finger side, working the forearm muscles that guide the wrist.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, thumb up.
Tilt your hand down toward the little finger side.
Pause briefly, then return to neutral under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2853.description: A roll up from lying with your hands behind your head, training the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Roll up to sit.
Reach forward.
Roll down with control.

2917.description: Walking while holding a heavy dumbbell in each hand. It builds grip strength, traps and overall posture.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and down and brace your abs.
Walk with quick, controlled steps without swinging the weights.
Cover the set distance, then lower the dumbbells safely.

3109.description: A side-to-side leap like a speed skater. It trains leg power, balance and stamina.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Leap sideways to the other leg.
Land softly and sweep the back leg behind you.
Swing your arms across your body for balance.
Immediately bound back the other way.
Keep your hips low and your chest forward.

3237.description: A raise done with a barbell anchored in a landmine setup, lifting out and up to shoulder height. It works the shoulders with a smooth arc.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, resting it on the front of your shoulders.
Keeping your core engaged and back straight, lift the barbell up and away from your body, raising it to shoulder height.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，将其放在肩膀前面。
保持核心收紧并保持背部挺直，将杠铃向上举起并远离身体，将其提升至肩膀高度。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3301.description: A planche hold with the knees tucked in toward the arms. It builds shoulder, chest and wrist strength as a stepping stone to the full planche.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back straight.
As you lower your body, lift your feet off the ground and bring your knees towards your chest.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then extend your legs back out and push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部挺直。
当你降低身体时，将双脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后向后伸展双腿，并将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3365.description: A deep bodyweight squat variation that builds leg strength and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips down and back into a deep squat.
Pause at the bottom without rounding your back.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

3493.description: A one-leg squat down to a low box, giving you a target depth. It builds single-leg strength and balance.
instructions: Stand in front of a low box or bench on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward and raise your arms for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3557.description: A kneeling push-up with the hands wider apart. It puts more emphasis on the chest.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.

3621.description: A crunch with a twist and arms extended to work the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms straight up.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to reach one side.
Return to center and twist the other way.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

3685.description: Lateral raises with your chest on an incline bench to remove cheating and isolate the delts.
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

3749.description: A bodyweight row using a bed sheet looped around a sturdy anchor, such as a closed door.
instructions: Anchor a bed sheet securely and hold both ends.
Lean back with your body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.

3813.description: A crunch where your arms and legs spread like a starfish and then come together. It is a beginner-friendly ab move.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your abs and press your lower back down.
Crunch up, bringing your elbows toward your knees as they pull in.
Lower back to the starfish position under control.
Breathe out as you crunch.

3877.description: A squat jump while holding a medicine ball, building explosive power in the legs.
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sink into a squat with your chest up.
Jump up as high as you can.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

4069.description: Bench press with two boards on the chest, giving a slightly longer range than the three board press.
instructions: Lie on a bench with two boards stacked on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the boards.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

4133.description: A one-sided deadlift holding the kettlebell at your side like a suitcase, training the core as well.
instructions: Stand beside a kettlebell and hinge to grip it.
Keep your back flat.
Stand up without leaning sideways.
Lower it back to the floor.
Switch hands after your set.

4197.description: Combine a pallof press with a glute bridge.
instructions: Lie on your back with a cable beside you.
Hold the handle at your chest.
Bridge your hips up.
Press the handle forward.
Return and lower.
Switch sides.

4389.description: An explosive overhead lift that uses a leg drive to send dumbbells overhead. It builds power and shoulder strength.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, feet hip-width apart.
Dip by bending your knees slightly while keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs explosively.
Press the dumbbells overhead as you straighten, then lock out your arms.
Lower them back to your shoulders with control.

4453.description: A standing single-arm row from a low anchor, using a band. Trains the lats and mid back one side at a time.
instructions: Anchor a band low and stand facing it, holding the end in one hand.
Step back until the band is taut, feet hip width apart.
Pull your elbow back and out, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Return slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

4581.description: A defensive boxing guard that covers your head and body from incoming punches.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with feet staggered and knees slightly bent.
Bring your fists up to your cheeks with elbows tucked in.
Keep your chin down.
Raise your forearms to cover your face as if blocking a punch.
Bring your elbows together to cover your ribs.
Reset to your guard and repeat.

4709.description: A jump with a shooting arm motion that trains explosive legs and coordination.
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with hands at chest height.
Dip into a quarter squat.
Jump up and extend one arm like shooting a basketball.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

4773.description: A seated chin-up with a narrow underhand grip, using your legs for some help. It builds the lats and biceps.
instructions: Sit under a low bar with your hands close together, palms facing you.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your back and arms at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

4837.description: A one-arm row in a hinged position. It builds the lats and upper back, one side at a time.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly and switch sides after your reps.

4901.description: A standing windmill with a dumbbell held overhead as you hinge to the side. It trains the obliques, hips and shoulder stability.
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead with one hand and stand with feet wide.
Turn your toes slightly away from the weight.
Push your hips out and hinge sideways.
Slide your free hand down your leg toward the floor.
Reverse the motion and stand tall.
Keep your eyes on the weight, then switch sides.

4965.description: A box jump that builds explosive leg power. It trains the whole lower body.
instructions: Stand facing a box with feet shoulder width.
Dip and swing your arms back.
Jump onto the box with both feet.
Land softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on the box.
Step down carefully.

5029.description: Rotating the upper back from a kneeling position. It improves spinal rotation and loosens the mid back.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with one hand behind your head.
Keep your hips still and your core lightly braced.
Rotate your elbow down toward the other arm, then open toward the ceiling.
Follow the elbow with your eyes.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

5093.description: Press one dumbbell up from the floor. Lying on the floor limits the range of motion and challenges your core to stay still.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a dumbbell at chest level.
Rest your other arm on the floor.
Press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is straight.
Lower it until your upper arm touches the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

5157.description: Hold a forearm plank and jump your feet apart and together. It trains the core while raising your heart rate.
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Jump your feet wide apart.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and continue for 20-40 seconds.

5349.description: Raise the leg out to the side against lever resistance. Targets the outer hips.
instructions: Set up in the machine with the pad on the outside of your leg.
Hold the supports for stability.
Raise your leg out to the side in a controlled motion.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

5477.description: Hanging-style leg raise performed supported on parallel bars, taking the legs high to challenge the lower abs.
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders pushed down.
Keep your legs together and slightly bent or straight.
Raise your legs until they reach hip height or higher, curling your pelvis.
Lower them slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the target reps.

5669.description: A barbell curl done with no body swing, so the biceps do all of the work. It is a simple way to build the front of the upper arm.
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and your torso still.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.

5861.description: Lie back and lower a kettlebell toward your forehead, then extend. It builds the triceps with elbows fixed.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Repeat with control.

5989.description: A run in a figure-eight around two cones, which builds agility, balance and quick turns.
instructions: Set two cones about 5 yards apart.
Start next to one cone in an athletic stance.
Run a figure-eight around both cones.
Lean into the turns and keep your hips low.
Run for 20-30 seconds, then change direction.

6053.description: A crunch that draws knees and chest together while holding a bottle. It trains the whole abdominal wall.
instructions: Lie on your back with soles together, knees open, holding a bottle on your chest.
Curl your upper body up as you pull your knees in.
Bring your chest toward your knees.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat.

6437.description: A band pulldown pulling the arm from out to your side down to your body. It trains the lats and shoulder control.
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handle with your arm raised.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull your arm down toward your side.
Keep your elbow straight or slightly bent.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

6693.description: A kneeling crunch to the side against a high cable. It targets the obliques with steady resistance.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel beside the stack.
Hold the rope at the side of your head.
Crunch sideways, bringing your elbow toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your side.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

6757.description: A one-arm standing curl. It builds the biceps and lets you focus on each arm separately.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side, palm facing forward.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

7205.description: A squat jump with a band around the thighs to keep the knees driving outward.
instructions: Place the band above your knees and stand with feet shoulder-width.
Squat down with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly, absorbing into the next squat.
Keep your knees pressing out against the band.
Repeat for the planned reps.

7589.description: A kneeling cable kickback that isolates the glutes.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and kneel on hands and knees facing it.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the cuffed leg back and up.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

8613.description: A preacher curl with a little controlled swing to push past the sticking point.
instructions: Rest your upper arms on a preacher pad and hold dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Keep your shoulders down.
Curl the weights up with a small drive from the bottom.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

9317.description: Holding the top of a pull up while seated helps you build pulling strength. It works the lats and arms.
instructions: Set up a bar so you can sit under it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Hold the top position.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.

9509.description: A seated machine raise where your knees stay bent, which emphasises the soleus under the calf.
instructions: Sit at the machine with the pads over your thighs and balls of your feet on the platform.
Lower your heels for a calf stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

9701.description: A lunge with an extra-long stride into a low position. It stretches the hips while working the glutes and thighs.
instructions: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a very long step forward.
Sink down until your back knee hovers above the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

10597.description: A cable drill with the upper arm at shoulder height and elbow bent to 90 degrees. It trains the rotator cuff to catch and control a quick rotation.
instructions: Set the cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Raise your upper arm out to the side with the elbow bent 90 degrees.
Let the cable pull your forearm back into external rotation.
Catch it, then rotate the forearm forward and down smoothly.
Keep your upper arm still and level.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

10661.description: A band-assisted single-arm pull-up on gymnastic rings. The rings add instability and grip demand.
instructions: Hang a band from the rings or bar and place your foot in it.
Grip one ring with one hand and hold the other ring loosely or let it go.
Pull your chest toward the ring.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Repeat, then switch sides.

10853.description: A reformer roll-over that mobilises the spine. It stretches the back and works the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet against the shoulder rests.
Press your legs straight up.
Roll your hips off the pad.
Lift your hips over your shoulders.
Roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.
Avoid pressing on your neck.

10917.description: A gentle seated press that engages the shin muscle. Useful for ankle control.
instructions: Sit on a chair with one foot flat and the other crossed over it.
Press the top foot up against the resistance of the bottom foot.
Feel the front of your shin work.
Hold for a second.
Relax and repeat, then switch feet.

11877.description: A hanging hold with legs straight out in front that challenges the abs and grip.
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight in front until they are parallel to the floor.
Keep your toes pointed and your knees locked.
Avoid swinging.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower.

0037.description: A wide-grip pullover on a decline bench. Stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your hips and your feet secured.
Hold a barbell with a wide grip and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Lower the barbell behind your head in a controlled manner, keeping your arms straight.
Pause for a moment, then raise the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，头部低于臀部，双脚固定。
宽握距握住杠铃，并将双臂伸直至胸部上方。
有控制地将杠铃降低到头后，保持手臂伸直。
暂停片刻，然后将杠铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0101.description: A fast, light back squat. Builds explosive leg power and speed out of the hole.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps or rear delts.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your hips back and down, as if sitting into a chair.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在斜方肌或三角肌后束上。
收紧核心肌群，保持挺胸，同时向后和向下降低臀部，就像坐在椅子上一样。
降低直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
通过脚跟发力站起来，在顶部挤压臀部。
重复所需的重复次数。

0165.description: A hammer curl with a rope attachment. Trains the biceps and brachialis.
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Hold the cable rope attachment with an underhand grip, palms facing each other, and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the cable rope attachment until your biceps are fully contracted and the rope is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the cable rope attachment back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手握住缆绳附件，手掌相对，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续提升缆绳附件，直到您的二头肌完全收缩并且绳索与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将缆绳附件降低回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0229.description: A standing cable curl with the palms facing up. Keep the elbows close and curl for a strong biceps contraction.
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable handle with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the cable handle towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
反手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝上。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将绳索手柄卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并缓慢地将电缆手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0293.description: A two-arm dumbbell row done bent over. You pull the weights to the chest to build the upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let your arms hang straight down towards the floor, with your elbows slightly bent.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
让你的手臂垂直垂向地板，肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0357.description: A single-arm dumbbell press with your upper back on a stability ball. Staying balanced makes your core work as hard as the chest.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with a dumbbell and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on the ball.
Lift your hips so your body is flat like a bench, feet wide for balance.
Hold the dumbbell at chest height and press it up over your shoulder.
Lower it slowly back to chest level.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
Keep your hips up and don't let your body twist.

0421.description: Standing and leaning forward, you curl one dumbbell with your elbow braced on your thigh. It isolates the biceps one side at a time.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Place your free hand on your thigh for support.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，一手握住哑铃，掌心朝上。
将空着的手放在大腿上以获得支撑。
保持上臂静止，呼气，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向肩膀弯曲。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0485.description: A second version of the hip bridge lifting the hips from the floor. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Place your arms at your sides.
Press through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Keep your ribs down and avoid overarching.

0549.description: A hip hinge move where you swing a kettlebell to chest height using your hips. Great for glutes, hamstrings and posterior chain power.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward.
Hold the kettlebell with both hands in front of your body, arms extended.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips, pushing your butt back.
Swing the kettlebell back between your legs, keeping your arms straight and maintaining a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and swing the kettlebell up to shoulder height, using the momentum generated by your hips.
Allow the kettlebell to swing back down between your legs and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
双手握住壶铃放在身体前方，双臂伸展。
稍微弯曲膝盖并铰接臀部，将臀部向后推。
将壶铃在两腿之间向后摆动，保持手臂伸直并保持背部平坦。
利用臀部产生的动量，向前推动臀部并将壶铃摆动到肩膀高度。
让壶铃在双腿之间向下摆动，然后重复该动作达到所需的重复次数。

0613.description: Lying on your side, you pull your top foot toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh. A gentle quad stretch.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight.
Bend your top leg and grab your ankle or foot with your hand.
Gently pull your ankle or foot towards your glutes until you feel a stretch in your quads.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸直。
弯曲上面的那条腿，用手抓住脚踝或脚。
轻轻地将脚踝或脚拉向臀部，直到感觉到股四头肌有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开拉伸并在另一侧重复。

0677.description: A dip performed on gymnastic rings. The unstable rings train the chest, triceps and shoulder stability.
instructions: Start by hanging from the rings with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，将手臂完全伸展，身体伸直，挂在吊环上。
弯曲肘部，降低身体，直到肩膀低于肘部。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0741.description: On a sled hack squat machine, you squat with your feet close together. Puts more focus on the quads.
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight and position yourself with your back against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, toes slightly pointed outwards.
Grip the handles on the sides of the machine for stability.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to extend your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机调整到舒适的重量，并将背部靠在垫子上。
将双脚分开与肩同宽放在平台上，脚趾稍微向外。
握住机器两侧的手柄以保持稳定性。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，调动核心力量，慢慢降低身体，保持背部挺直。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或略低于地面。
在底部停顿片刻，然后用脚跟推动双腿并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0805.description: A fallout with suspension straps, leaning forward and lowering the body with straight arms. It builds deep core strength in the abs.
instructions: Attach a suspension trainer to a high anchor point and adjust the straps to waist height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point and hold the handles with your arms extended in front of you.
Lean forward at the waist, keeping your body straight and your core engaged.
Lower your body as far as you can while maintaining control and tension in your abs.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly raise your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将悬挂训练器连接到高锚点并将带子调整至腰部高度。
背对锚点站立，并握住手柄，双臂向前伸展。
腰部向前倾，保持身体挺直，核心肌群参与。
尽可能降低身体，同时保持腹肌的控制和紧张。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢抬起身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0869.description: A machine shoulder press with a lever arm, pressing the handles overhead. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles of the machine with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles upward and forward until your arms are fully extended, but not locked.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机的座椅高度和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住机器的手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
向上和向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，但未锁定。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0997.description: A shoulder press with a band under the feet. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band with your palms facing forward and raise your hands to shoulder height, elbows bent.
Press the band overhead, fully extending your arms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下。
手掌朝前握住弹力带，将双手举至肩高，肘部弯曲。
将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将阻力带降低至肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。
